EQUIVALENT: bracket expansion on NPV(hi) > 0 vs >= 0 differs only when NPV(hi) is exactly 0, where both converge to the same root hi.
EQUIVALENT: hi starts at 1.0 and doubles, so it is a power of two and never equals 1e9.

EQUIVALENT: stopping at hi-lo < tol vs <= tol moves the stop by at most one bisection step at 1e-12; every IRR assertion against a literal is abs=1e-10 or coarser; the one abs=1e-12 IRR assertion (tests/test_labels.py) compares two IRRs from the same solver, which this mutant moves together.
EQUIVALENT: initial upper bracket 1.0 vs 1.1; any hi with NPV(hi) <= 0 brackets the unique root of a single-outflow-then-inflows vector.

UNREACHABLE in practice via the public API: moves the solver's refusal cap. investor.analyze reaches an IRR near the cap only for a credit price within about 3e-10 of 0.05/0.39 (measured: +3e-10 gives IRR 4.27e8 and computes; +1e-10 exceeds the cap and is refused with REFUSAL_IRR_BOUND).
EQUIVALENT: lower-bracket offset from -100% of 1e-9 vs 1.1e-9; differs only for a root within ~1e-9 of -100%.

EQUIVALENT at test precision: bisection tolerance 1e-12 vs 1.1e-12; every IRR assertion against a literal is abs=1e-10 or coarser; the one abs=1e-12 IRR assertion (tests/test_labels.py) compares two IRRs from the same solver, which this mutant moves together.
EQUIVALENT: bracket growth factor 2.0 vs 2.2; any factor > 1 reaches an hi with NPV(hi) <= 0 and bisection then converges to the same unique root.
EQUIVALENT: max_iter 500 vs 501; the tolerance break fires after 41-44 iterations (measured on the sample deal's flows, [-100,110], [-1,10], [-100,0.5]), so the cap is never reached.
